description: This is a Java class file defining LogView, a custom TextView component that implements LogNode for logging purposes within an Android application. It formats log messages and displays them in the UI.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log messages and implements LogNode for chaining log operations.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructors initializing the LogView with Context and optional AttributeSet or style.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs log data received from the LogNode interface, appending it to the TextView and passing it along the chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method that appends strings to a StringBuilder with separators if they are not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends the given string as a new line to the LogView display.
